explanation: erdosproblems.com/652: 'we always have R(x_1)R(x_2) ≫ n'. The Lean statement gives c > 0 with c·n ≤ R(p)·R(q) for every pair of distinct points p, q of every finite set. This is equivalent to the page's claim for the two smallest values (and true, since each other point is determined up to 2 choices by its distances to p and q). Faithful.
